event.text: You can manage this at home for now: wash the area and any clothing that touched the plants, keep the skin cool and moisturized, and avoid scratching; a pharmacist can advise on over-the-counter options for itch. See a clinician if the rash spreads well beyond the contact area, blisters or weeps, becomes painful, warm or feverish, or isn't settling. If you develop throat tightness, facial swelling or trouble breathing, call 911.
